## What changed and why?

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## How was it checked?

List the commands run. For UI changes, include phone/desktop screenshots and the browsers tested. For text changes, include the language and chapter/passage IDs.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This change is focused and preserves unrelated behavior.
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, personal data or local credential files are included.
- [ ] I have the right to submit any new text, code, audio, fonts or images; sources and licenses are documented.
- [ ] Changed dialogue is flagged for translation and narration updates.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the current licensing status.
